title: C++ Functions
description: Declaring, defining and calling functions: parameters, return values, default arguments, references, overloading and recursion.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 函式的宣告、定義與呼叫：參數、回傳值、預設引數、參考、重載與遞迴。

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a function declaration and a function definition?

prompt.zh-Hant: 函式宣告與函式定義有甚麼分別？

a.zh-Hant: 宣告只描述簽名，定義提供本體

b.zh-Hant: 宣告提供本體，定義只描述簽名

d.zh-Hant: 定義只能出現在標頭檔

explanation.zh-Hant: 宣告（原型）告訴編譯器名稱、參數與回傳型別；定義另外提供函式本體，且整個程式只能定義一次。

options.text: A declaration describes the signature; a definition provides the body
A declaration provides the body; a definition only describes the signature
They are exactly the same thing
A definition may only appear in a header

questions.explanation: A declaration (prototype) tells the compiler the name, parameters and return type. A definition also supplies the body, and there must be exactly one definition in the program.

questions.prompt: Which declaration of default arguments is valid?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個預設引數的宣告是合法的？

c.zh-Hant: `void f(int a, int b = 2, int c);`

d.zh-Hant: `void f(int a = 1, int b = 2, int c = 3, int d);`

explanation.zh-Hant: 預設引數必須從右向左連續提供；一旦某個參數有預設值，它右邊的參數也必須有。

options.text: `void f(int a = 1, int b = 2);`
`void f(int a = 1, int b);`
`void f(int a, int b = 2, int c);`
`void f(int a = 1, int b = 2, int c = 3, int d);`

questions.explanation: Default arguments must be supplied from right to left: once a parameter has a default, every parameter to its right must also have one.

questions.prompt: When a function takes an `int` by value and changes it, what does the caller see?

prompt.zh-Hant: 函式以傳值方式接收 `int` 並修改它，呼叫端會看到甚麼？

b.zh-Hant: 呼叫端的原變數被修改

explanation.zh-Hant: 傳值會複製一份引數，函式修改的是副本；要修改呼叫端必須傳參考或指標。

options.text: The caller's original variable is unchanged
The caller's original variable is modified
It is a compile error
Undefined behaviour

questions.explanation: Passing by value copies the argument, so the function changes the copy. To modify the caller's object, pass a reference or a pointer.

questions.prompt: What must every recursive function have to avoid infinite recursion?

prompt.zh-Hant: 每個遞迴函式都必須具備甚麼，才能避免無限遞迴？

a.zh-Hant: 一個會在適當時候停止遞迴的基底情況

explanation.zh-Hant: 遞迴必須逐步縮小問題並在基底情況直接回傳，否則會不斷呼叫自己直到堆疊耗盡。

options.text: A base case that stops the recursion at the right point
At least two parameters
A global variable
The `inline` specifier

questions.explanation: A recursion must shrink the problem and return directly at a base case. Without it the function calls itself until the stack is exhausted.

questions.prompt: Which statements about function overloading are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於函式重載，下列敘述何者正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 參數型別或數量不同即可重載。

b.zh-Hant: 只有回傳型別不同不足以構成重載。

c.zh-Hant: 預設引數可能令多個重載版本難以分辨。

d.zh-Hant: 同名同參數但回傳型別不同是合法的重載。

explanation.zh-Hant: 重載依簽名（名稱＋參數）區分；回傳型別不參與，所以只有回傳值不同不合法。預設引數會讓呼叫端可能同時匹配多個版本。

options.text: Different parameter types or counts make an overload.
A different return type alone is not enough.
Default arguments can make overloads ambiguous.
Same name and parameters with a different return type is a valid overload.

questions.explanation: Overloads differ by signature (name plus parameters); the return type is not part of it, so changing only the return type is invalid. Default arguments can make a call match more than one overload.

questions.prompt: Why pass a large object as `const std::string&` instead of by value? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為何大型物件應以 `const std::string&` 傳遞，而不是傳值？可多選。

b.zh-Hant: const 保證函式不會修改它

c.zh-Hant: 可以接受字串字面值等隱式轉換

d.zh-Hant: 參考一定比傳值快，與型別無關

explanation.zh-Hant: const 參考避免複製並保留唯讀保證，也能綁定暫存物件；但對小型內建型別，傳值往往同樣快。

options.text: It avoids copying the whole object.
`const` promises the function will not modify it.
It still accepts implicit conversions such as a string literal.
A reference is always faster, regardless of the type.

questions.explanation: A const reference avoids a copy and documents read-only intent, and it can bind to temporaries. For small built-in types, passing by value is often just as fast.

questions.prompt: A function declared with return type `void` can still return a value to its caller.

prompt.zh-Hant: 回傳型別為 `void` 的函式仍然可以把值回傳給呼叫端。

explanation.zh-Hant: void 表示不回傳值；只能寫 `return;` 提早結束。要回傳值必須使用非 void 型別。

questions.explanation: void means no value is returned; only a bare `return;` is allowed to exit early. Returning a value requires a non-void type.

questions.prompt: A function prototype must repeat the parameter names used in the definition.

prompt.zh-Hant: 函式原型必須重複定義中所使用的參數名稱。

explanation.zh-Hant: 原型只需參數型別，名稱可省略；名稱只影響可讀性。

questions.explanation: A prototype only needs the parameter types. Names are optional and exist for readability.

questions.prompt: The specifier that suggests the compiler expand a small function at each call site is ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 建議編譯器在每個呼叫點展開小型函式的修飾詞是 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: inline 只是建議，編譯器可自行決定；它同時放寬了多個編譯單元定義同一函式的限制。

questions.explanation: inline is a hint the compiler may ignore. It also relaxes the one-definition rule so a function can be defined in a header.

questions.prompt: Explain why a missing base case in a recursive function causes a crash.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明遞迴函式缺少基底情況為何會導致程式崩潰。

model.zh-Hant: 每次遞迴呼叫都會在堆疊上保留一個新的堆疊框架；若沒有基底情況停止，呼叫會無限增加，最終耗盡堆疊空間而崩潰（stack overflow）。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵是堆疊空間有限，而每層呼叫都佔用一部分。

answer.model: Every recursive call keeps a new stack frame alive. Without a base case the calls never stop, the stack grows until its limit is reached, and the program crashes with a stack overflow.

questions.explanation: Stack space is finite and each pending call holds a frame, so unbounded recursion exhausts it.
